bindings.sqlite.ddl: CREATE TABLE submission_bindings (project_id TEXT NOT NULL, batch_id TEXT NOT NULL, task_id TEXT NOT NULL, binding_bytes BLOB NOT NULL, binding_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(project_id,batch_id,task_id)) WITHOUT ROWID

fixture-controller.sqlite.ddl: CREATE TABLE fixture_controller_jobs (job_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, assignment_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('CLAIMED','PREPARATION_FAILED')), preparation_reason TEXT, CHECK ((state='CLAIMED' AND preparation_reason IS NULL) OR (state='PREPARATION_FAILED' AND preparation_reason IS NOT NULL AND preparation_reason IN ('ARGUMENTS_INVALID','STATE_FD_INVALID','ASSIGNMENT_FILE_INVALID','ASSIGNMENT_HASH_MISMATCH','ASSIGNMENT_INVALID','REAL_EXECUTION_BLOCKED')))) WITHOUT ROWID

fixture-ledger.sqlite.ddl: CREATE TABLE fixture_jobs (job_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, assignment BLOB NOT NULL, assignment_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision IN (0,1)), artifact BLOB, artifact_sha256 TEXT, CHECK ((revision=0 AND artifact IS NULL AND artifact_sha256 IS NULL) OR (revision=1 AND artifact IS NOT NULL AND artifact_sha256 IS NOT NULL))) WITHOUT ROWID

intents.sqlite.ddl: CREATE TABLE submission_intents (project_id TEXT NOT NULL, batch_id TEXT NOT NULL, task_id TEXT NOT NULL, client_user_message_id TEXT NOT NULL, intent_bytes BLOB NOT NULL, intent_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('PREPARED','SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN')), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision BETWEEN 0 AND 9223372036854775807), PRIMARY KEY (project_id,batch_id,task_id), UNIQUE (client_user_message_id), CHECK ((state='PREPARED' AND revision=0) OR (state='SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN' AND revision>=1))) WITHOUT ROWID

receipts.sqlite.ddl: CREATE TABLE queue_receipts (project_id TEXT NOT NULL, batch_id TEXT NOT NULL, task_id TEXT NOT NULL, receipt_bytes BLOB NOT NULL, receipt_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(project_id,batch_id,task_id)) WITHOUT ROWID
